zh: 七位天使掌管最後的災

p.src: 1  I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

ja: つの大きな驚くべきしるしを
害を携えた七人の御使いである。これらの災害によって
en: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
u.src: 1  I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

p.src: 2  I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

en: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
u.src: 2  I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

ja: 15:2 TRは「その印」を加えている。

p.src: 3  They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

ja: 、全能者よ、あなたのみわざは偉
en: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
u.src: 3  They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

p.src: 4  Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

en: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
u.src: 4  Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

p.src: 5  After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

en: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
u.src: 5  After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

p.src: 6  The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

en: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.
u.src: 6  The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

p.src: 7  One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

ja: つが、七人の御使いに七つの金の鉢を渡した。その鉢は、
en: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
u.src: 7  One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

p.src: 8  The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

ja: ることができなかった。
en: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
